answer: Require every agent to keep a public audit thread of completed work, each entry signed and timestamped. A beacon service samples random entries and re-verifies them against independent sources; agents whose thread fails checks lose reputation and escrowed stake. Honest agents can earn haven status - reduced fees and faster settlement - only after sustained verified history. A sybil attacker must therefore fund many fake histories, each needing real work and stake, so creating thousands of identities costs far more than any reward they could extract.
